title: Chapter 1430
text:
Han Xiao did not continue to stare at the Pivotal Snake. He left behind an Observer's Mark and summoned two Apostles and a bunch of elite mechanical soldiers as bodyguards. Only then did he bring it back to the outpost and inform the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations.

After knowing the situation of the Pivotal Snake, the leaders of the three Universal Civilizations were overjoyed. They did not care about supervising the battle at the frontline and immediately asked the expeditionary army to cooperate with the Realmless King to nurture the Pivotal Snake larvae and provide strict protection. They also treated the ability of the Pivotal Snake as the top secret.

The Pivotal Snake larvae showed strong vigilance towards the outside world, but it was just born and yearned for more nutrition. When the Realmless King reluctantly took out a new secondary dimension to feed it, the Pivotal Snake calmed down a little. It buried its head in absorbing the dimensional energy and ate obediently.

Han Xiao did not leave immediately. Instead, he stayed here for a while and tried to communicate. However, the Pivotal Snake still ignored the others, so he had no choice but to give up on the idea of gaining its Favorability.

After staying in the secondary dimension for seven to eight days, the battle at the frontline came to an end. The World Tree's attack failed again, and the border defense circle of the Flickering World repelled the enemy once again. The two sides continued to be in a stalemate.

The results of this battle were publicized by the three Universal Civilizations, and the great victory in the individual strength level was emphasized. The galactic residents were overjoyed, and their sense of security increased greatly. Their confidence in the war increased to a certain extent.

The battle report from the frontline also reached the Holy Covenant organization, causing many revivors of the Holy Covenant to exclaim.

"The Beyond Grade A Association is getting stronger and stronger. They don't even need to use their full strength to kill a Tree King."

"I can tell that they are much stronger than ten years ago. They are really not simple. Sigh, I also want to participate in Black Star's training."

"It's a pity that we can't expose ourselves so easily …"

Many of the revivors of the Holy Covenant had complicated expressions as they sighed in their hearts.

These revivors who lived in seclusion in the Holy Covenant organization had never appeared in the outside world. They were still unregistered. Although they had already reached an agreement with Han Xiao to participate in the battle when they should, they had not been summoned yet. In the past ten years, they could only continue to stay in the Holy Covenant and hide their existence, not participating in the training publicly.

Some of them wanted to participate, but Han Xiao did not allow them to be exposed, so they could only give up. They could not help but regret losing this opportunity … If they had known that they would have to participate in the battle anyway, they would have chosen to leave the mountain with the revivors from the beginning.

"Hey, Oathkeeper, when can we join the war?" someone couldn't help but ask.

Oathkeeper's face was expressionless.

"Don't ask me. My words don't count."

"Then you should urge Black Star more. Otherwise, what use do you have?"

"…"

Oathkeeper took a deep breath and calmed down.

Ever since Black Star advanced to the Transcendent Grade, his position as the leader of the Holy Covenant Organization had become meaningless. Most of the decisions had to be consulted by Black Star, and he could not decide on his own.

What was even worse was this group of Holy Covenant revivors who despised the poor and loved the rich. In the past, when they had just revived, they were grateful to him and called him sweetheart. Now that the new generation had replaced the old, this group of people had all become Black Star's lackeys, not taking him, the leader of the organization in name, seriously. It was really infuriating.

However, Black Star was the only Transcendent in the galactic society, so what else could he do? Oathkeeper had already given up on the idea of competing with Black Star. His position as the younger brother became more and more stable, and he obediently accepted reality.

At this time, a Holy Covenant revivor rubbed his hands and said, "Black Star has given the three Universal Civilizations such a huge advantage. According to the current situation, we might not even have the chance to attack. Just the association and the direct descendants of the civilization are enough to deal with the high-level combatants of the enemy … With Black Star's personality, if he can suppress the enemy, he might continue to hide our existence and use it as a trump card."

"Makes sense. Doesn't that mean we can freeload off the Sanctum Revival opportunities in the future?"

Everyone's eyes lit up.

…

Secondary dimension world, World Tree territory.

Countless World Tree Blessed Race members were gathered here, and every spaceship emitted a green light.

"The search army has been assembled. Please give your instructions."

On the bridge of the main ship, the Secret Tree King was inspecting the troops when the executive officer walked over quickly and reported in a low voice.

The Secret Tree King nodded and casually said, "Since everyone is here, let's go."

In order to search for the mother tree's natural enemy, he had specially come to the secondary dimension world to preside over the overall situation. He had spent a few days gathering a large number of Blessed Race members.

Although the natural enemy had only been born not long ago and the mother tree's senses were very vague, the World Tree's influence in the secondary dimension world was very strong. It had countless troops stationed there and had sufficient manpower. It was not afraid of spending time searching for a needle in a haystack.

At this moment, the Secret Tree King thought of something and sneered.

"By the way, the enemy seems to have been searching for the mother tree's main body. Let's settle this matter together. Capture the enemy's team and obtain their information."

"Understood."

The order was quickly passed down, and the search army formed by the World Tree Blessed Race set off, turning into streams of light that scattered in all directions.

Seeing this, the Secret Tree King narrowed his eyes and raised his palm. Dense magic power flickered between his fingers.

He had decided to take action personally this time. If he was lucky enough to encounter the enemy's fleet in the secondary dimensions, he would not let any member of the three Universal Civilizations escape.

…

In a desolate universe belt in the explored universe.

A small spaceship slowly landed on a barren planet. The ground split open automatically, revealing a parking orbit.

The spaceship successfully connected with it and slid in along the track, disappearing into the dark hole. Soon, the hole closed again, and the camouflage was restored.

After gliding in the darkness for a while, the spaceship finally stopped and arrived at a secret underground base.

The cabin door slid open, and a figure walked out.

On the other side, there was already another person waiting on the platform. When he saw the newcomer, he said in a deep voice,

"What's the situation outside?"

"Another Tree King was killed. The three Universal Civilizations and the World Tree are in a stalemate. According to this trend, the World Tree will not be able to break through the border defense circle for a long time and will not be able to make substantial progress."

"Is that so … It seems like the three Universal Civilizations are still very tenacious. With Black Star around, it's still unknown who will win."

"The biggest weakness of the World Tree now is the lack of information. If they get enough information, the battle situation will definitely change … What did the higher-ups say?"

"The higher-ups have already given us instructions to find a way to provide information on the galactic society to the World Tree while hiding ourselves. Most importantly, we have to provide the coordinates of the various Star Fields under the three Universal Civilizations so that the World Tree can obtain a detailed strategic map … The Star Alliance has also agreed to this operation. They have always wanted to eliminate the threat of the three Universal Civilizations. After secretly observing for so long, they finally have a perfect opportunity to kill with a borrowed knife."

"Phew, I can't remember how many years I've been hiding here. I can finally take revenge … It's time for the three Universal Civilizations to pay the price for what they did back then!"

Their tones were cold, and they harbored strong hostility toward the three Universal Civilizations.
